messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Mercer Benchmarks <benchmarks@mercer.com>, Remuneration Partners <hr@rempartners.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:06:00 -0800
Subject: Salary band rollout: final benchmarking and implementation notes

Team — attaching v4 of the proposed salary bands and the Mercer regional benchmark we commissioned. This thread is to capture final comments on: 1) the geo-differential multipliers, 2) leveling clarifications for L3/L4 engineers and principal ICs, and 3) the implementation checklist for offers and approvals next quarter.

Top asks: 
- Mercer: confirm the mid-market percentile we used (65th) is defensible for our growth targets and give any quick caveats.
- Remuneration Partners: please review the comp spreadsheet for any local regulatory traps for the EU/UK markets.
- Internal: Markus / Monica / Aditya — please call out any immediate impacts on open offers and the FY27 HC plan.

Attachments: salary_band_proposal_v4.xlsx (master table), geo_benchmarks_mercer_2026.pdf, implementation-checklist.docx

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Mercer Benchmarks <benchmarks@mercer.com>, Remuneration Partners <hr@rempartners.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 10:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Salary band rollout: final benchmarking and implementation notes

Kimberly — quick read-through. High level thoughts: 
- The L3/L4 leveling language in the spreadsheet is slightly thin; suggest we add explicit example role mappings (frontend/backend/infra) to avoid confusion during offer creation.
- The geo multipliers look OK for primary hubs (SF, NYC, London) but I'd like a narrower band for smaller APAC markets; recommend a +/−5% cap on local adjustments.

I'll add inline comments to v4.

— Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Remuneration Partners <hr@rempartners.com>, Mercer Benchmarks <benchmarks@mercer.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Salary band rollout: final benchmarking and implementation notes

Thanks Kim — a couple of operational notes from Talent Ops/GC: 
- Headcount impact: if we adopt the proposed midpoints at the 65th percentile, FY27 offer budgets will need an incremental $1.2M headcount reserve (est.). I put a draft line in the implementation checklist (tab: budget-impact).
- Offers in flight: we have 8 pending offers in EMEA and 5 in US that will need market adjustments if we finalize these bands. Recommend a two-week buffer to reconcile offer letters and get approvals.

I'll sync with Finance this afternoon and post updated numbers.

Monica
Monica Patel
Director, Talent Operations
From: Mercer Benchmarks <benchmarks@mercer.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Remuneration Partners <hr@rempartners.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 07:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Salary band rollout: Mercer regional notes attached

Hi Kimberly / team — attaching a short memo and adjusted percentile curves (see geo_benchmarks_mercer_2026.pdf). Summary: 
- 65th percentile is appropriate for high-growth engineering organizations in NA/EU; for APAC markets we recommend using a blended 55th percentile for early-stage hires and 60th for established hires due to local market scarcity differentials.
- Currency volatility callout: for GBP/EUR, we recommend quarterly review windows and collar bands to limit mid-year churn.
- Data sources: our dataset uses live vacancy data + compensation surveys through Q3 2026.

Attachment: geo_benchmarks_mercer_2026.pdf

Regards,
Sophie Martins
Senior Consultant — Mercer Benchmarks
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Mercer Benchmarks <benchmarks@mercer.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 10:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Salary band rollout: final benchmarking and implementation notes

Kimberly / team — added a few comments in v4 regarding offer-level approvals and the proposal to require Director sign-off for any offer > 110% of midpoint. Operational note: requiring Director sign-off will add latency to hiring in high-velocity teams; suggest an auto-approval path for bench-marked offers from Recruiting with a daily exception report to Finance.

Also: for quant roles, we should map to the Principal IC band explicitly — the current leveling table lumps quant/data roles with SWEs. Happy to help map examples.

— Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head of Recruiting (Americas)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Contracts Counsel <contracts@lawfirm.com>, Mercer Benchmarks <benchmarks@mercer.com>, Remuneration Partners <hr@rempartners.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Salary band rollout: request for final approval

Laura — forwarding the thread with consolidated edits (see attached implementation-checklist.docx). Key decision points for approval: 
1) Adopt 65th percentile baseline for NA/EU, blended APAC approach (Mercer rec).
2) Director sign-off threshold at 110% of midpoint with auto-approval path for recruiter-submitted, benchmarked offers.
3) Approve a $1.2M headcount reserve for FY27 offers to accommodate band changes.

Attachments: implementation-checklist.docx, salary_band_proposal_v4.xlsx

Appreciate quick eyes — if we can sign off by EOD Friday we can issue updated offer templates Monday.

Thanks,
Kimberly
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Contracts Counsel <contracts@lawfirm.com>, Mercer Benchmarks <benchmarks@mercer.com>, Remuneration Partners <hr@rempartners.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 15:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Salary band rollout: request for final approval

Kimberly — I reviewed the checklist and the budget note. Approve the plan with the following conditions: 
- Finance to confirm the $1.2M reserve is funded from the hiring contingency line; Monica to confirm by COB Friday.
- Contracts counsel to review the EU market language for benefits and statutory withholdings and sign off on offer letter templates.
- Quarterly review cadence for bands (first review March 2027).

Once Monica confirms the funding and Counsel clears the EU wording, proceed with rollout. Good work on getting the benchmarking locked down.

Laura Bennett
